claims.claim: row synthesis admits tokens by CENTER containment, not full-bbox containment
claims.condition: outer.x0 <= cx <= outer.x1 and outer.y0 <= cy <= outer.y1
claims.resulting_ir_artifact: n/a (used as a gate, not stored)

claims.claim: orphan tokens eligible for row synthesis are those inside table.bbox by center
a synthesized row requires corroboration across >=2 columns
synthesized cell bbox is built from RAW TOKEN EDGES (min/max), not centers
claims.condition: y0 = min(t.bbox.y0 for t in cluster); y1 = max(t.bbox.y1 for t in cluster)

claims.claim: the synthesis marker is Cell.confidence == 0.5, set at exactly one line
table.bbox is never reassigned after synthesis (no expansion)
claims.condition: grep for 'table.bbox =' in this range: 0 hits

claims.claim: row/col VALUES are corrected after synthesis via _renumber_rows_by_position, but this does not touch cell bbox
claims.condition: reassigns c.row from sorted y0 bands; no bbox mutation in the function body

claims.claim: Table Transformer's structure-recognition backend takes no OCR input (rules out OCR-backend as a direct cause of geometry differences)
claims.condition: "identical across whether it's fed OCR'd" (documented design invariant)
